content:
Ravi (Partnerships): Quick win to share  HelixSure (insurance tech) signed a 2yr Dedicated capacity deal + ISV listing on AWS Marketplace, and they're starting a Private VPC pilot for EU-regulated customers. Public launch planned next Tue morning. :tada:
Ava (Sales): Amazing news  congrats team. Who's pulling the customer case study and can we get a short quote from their Head of Ops?
Elena (Marketing): I'll own the case study. Need: 1 short quote (<= 140 chars), a 2-sentence customer profile, and a high-res logo. Prefer by EOD tomorrow so we can prepare the blog + social.
Tomas (Solutions): Tech notes: pinned model -> `rwd-flan-13b-quant`, autoscale group for dedicated GPUs in eu-west1 created, canary routing enabled (10%). We'll enable prefix caching and KV warming tonight. Will share perf numbers after the smoke tests.
Noah (Finance): Contract signed, 2yr committed ARR = $750,000 (reserved capacity). PO to be issued; revenue schedule on file. Add billing contact: billing@helixsure.com.
CBot: CRM: Opportunity OP-10242 marked Closed-Won by Ravi. Created onboarding ticket ONB-7702.
Ava (Sales): Does Marketplace listing need any special copy for the card? Also, do we have approval to co-brand social posts?
Ravi (Partnerships): HelixSure legal approved a short quote: "Redwood gave us predictable inference with enterprise-grade isolation  a must for insurance data." They also approved co-branded posts. Brand assets in drive: `/partners/helixsure/brand/`
Elena (Marketing): Draft announcement uploaded: https://redwood.workplace/drafts/helixsure-launch.md. Asking for any legal redlines before EOD. Will request a 45-60s CTO clip for the main blog.
Tomas (Solutions): I'll coordinate the CTO clip; can do a 20-min technical interview and capture a short soundbite. Also, checklist for launch: 
- Warm KV cache (scheduled)
- Run perf smoke in eu-west1 (Tomas)
- Validate SLOs: p95 < 180ms for generation (initial)
- Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 hours
- Enable audit logging to their KMS key
DeployBot: AWS Marketplace publish complete  listing id `aws-mkt-0xB12`. Listing URL: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/B0XXXXXX. Indexing may take 15-45 minutes.
Noah (Finance): Note: deal includes an advanced support add-on. Please tag finance in any scope changes.
Ava (Sales): Shoutout to @Ravi and @Tomas for the fast turnaround. Also looping in CS to schedule a kickoff next week.
CBot: Onboarding ticket ONB-7702: initial SRE runbook attached and first onboarding call scheduled for Wed 10am CET.
Elena (Marketing): Final checklist for comms: quote submitted (received), logo + brand assets (received), CTO clip (Tomas to deliver), legal sign-off (received). I'll queue social for Tue 9am CET.
Ravi (Partnerships): Assigning actions: @Elena - publish blog + social; @Tomas - perf results + CTO clip; @Noah - confirm PO and billing; @Ava - coordinate CS kickoff. Closing thread  will post final launch note when marketplace indexing completes. :rocket:
